cohort: 39 term infants born by planned cesarean section at Leiden University Medical Centre, Netherlands
finding: KCF at birth was feasible in a large proportion of term infants born by planned CS, with visible expulsion of liquid in a significant proportion of these infants.
mod_finding: This study investigated the feasibility of performing a knee-to-chest flexion maneuver in infants born by planned cesarean section to aid in expelling excess lung liquid.
